content: MK's note: it is difficult to determine the label's connotations (freethinking subversives, or neo-batinis, even Ismaʿilis); the last is "not beyond the realm of possibility" given hostility to Ismaʿilis under Temur and Shahrukh (Shahrukh's attempted purge of Ismaʿilis in Quhistan in 1415).
